Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner failed to accurately synthesize the information gathered from the WebSurfer's second search. While the WebSurfer correctly identified that Egon Zehnder's official site describes its services as "Organizational Consulting & Leadership Advisory" (visible in the page title and meta description), the Planner incorrectly concluded that the firm's field is "Private Equity." This error stems from a misinterpretation of the navigation menu items ("Industries > Private Equity") as the definition of the firm's primary field, rather than recognizing that "Private Equity" is merely one of many industries the firm serves. The Planner ignored the explicit service description provided by the firm itself in favor of a specific industry category, leading to an inaccurate final answer.
